content: PostgreSQL SELECT INTO without STRICT silently sets target to first row or NULLs on zero rows (no error); Oracle SELECT INTO always raises NO_DATA_FOUND on zero rows and TOO_MANY_ROWS on multiple rows. Must add STRICT to PL/pgSQL SELECT INTO to replicate Oracle single-row semantics, but only where Oracle relied on that exception, not blanket-applied. PostgreSQL exception handling is coarser-grained (SQLSTATE-based) vs Oracle named exceptions.
